name: ui-layouts-file-upload
title: File Upload
blurb: Drag-and-drop file uploader with keyboard navigation and validation.
description: Composable file upload component using react-dropzone. Supports drag-and-drop or click-to-select, with file size and count validation, keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter, Space, Delete), and a context-based architecture for flexible…
use_when: You need a customizable file upload with full keyboard support and drag-and-drop functionality.
avoid_when: The component requires react-dropzone and sonner toast notifications as dependencies.
a11y: Keyboard accessible: arrow keys navigate files, Enter/Space opens picker, Delete removes files, Escape clears focus. Focus tracking via activeIndex. Uses aria-description for content holder.
